Review disposition for the updated candidate:

- Accepted the failed-launch cleanup finding. The registered RPC regressions reproduced leaked retained access on both upload-preparation rejection and view-fetch rejection. Launch now has one cleanup guard and transfers the borrow to the installed view only after successful preparation and current-authority validation.

The [OpenAI extension specification](https://github.com/openai/mcp-extensions/blob/main/docs/spec.md) declares `ifMatch?: string` with the explicit comment **“Omit to write without a version check.”** It also says: “If `ifMatch` is provided, the resource will only be updated if the ETag provided matches the latest value.” This implementation intentionally supports both conditional and unconditional saves. Both require a prior writable read, the exact host-issued file URI, and current session/requester/file authority. The docs now state the last-writer-wins tradeoff explicitly and recommend ETags for concurrent editing. The registered-route tests preserve both branches; the live conditional-save test preserves an intervening external edit. No force-save option or broader file grant is being added.
- The optional versioned harness capability is the narrow existing-owner extension needed for the maintainer-requested full native feature. It adds no required method to existing plugins and is documented with its authority/lifecycle contract. Unsupported native runtimes fail closed rather than opening a second transport. The feature remains opt-in through the existing Apps setting; no new default, database schema, retention policy, or migration is introduced.
- The actual Apps-page conflict with main was resolved using main’s subscription owner, preserving App launch state. Focused UI proof passed.

- Accepted the ordinary-turn runtime invalidation and missing native-startup signal findings. Canonical selection now owns App validity; observed last-run fields cannot retire a valid view. Cold preparation retains cancellation authority. The runtime suite failed ten cases before repair and passes all twenty; a real mounted App survives an ordinary turn and then performs approved read/write calls through the same view.
- Accepted onboarding custody and concurrent cold-start findings. Real router/transcript tests prove onboarding input survives the outer ACK while caller/session revocation still blocks it. Cold native preparation uses the existing reentrant binding lease; waiting discoveries reuse the established owner. No second connection, lock owner, or persisted schema was added.
- Rejected the later queued-borrow concern after inspecting the unchanged SDK contract: warm App interactions explicitly borrow the conversation-owned native connection without preparation. The queued path is equivalent. A real lifecycle/client regression proves Alice and restricted Bob share one startup while Bob keeps his identity and denied-tool projection. Contract-aware independent review is clean.
- Native forms respect upstream policy: Full access maps to native approval policy `never`, so Codex may decline before forwarding. Workspace-mode real native forms returned canonical answers and uploaded resource URIs. Concurrent reference-app thumbnail calls can occupy the single native elicitation route; the focused form proof used an authenticated, unmounted file-view launch to avoid unrelated background work, not an alternate transport.
- Native transport-loss investigation reproduced a proof-launcher hazard: `bwrap --die-with-parent` dies when a short-lived spawning thread exits. A stable test supervisor keeps every sandbox flag; the short-lived-thread control and a real native RPC after 15 seconds idle pass. No production permissions or isolation were weakened.

Product build and selected isolated direct/native acceptance are complete; the PR is ready for review, not merged. The first exact-head CI exposed type-import cycles, an unused test-only production export, and a Node database seed helper in the UI runtime tree. These ownership defects are now repaired with a complete caller cutover; Madge, the exact storage-boundary regression, focused form/native/UI tests, types, lint, and strict UI performance passed. - Accepted the native overload-retry P1. The shared client remains open in every case. Upstream Codex was inspected at `8f73cdee456b6c46b791780d40cadf9d556d22a4`; its ingress overload response rejects before queue admission.
